# Finish Copilot setup reliability after the CI cleanup

Copilot setup can lose a useful native failure when it trims empty Git or Node output, stop after a transient fetch or Node download failure, or inherit npm configuration before checking the installed runtime. This change preserves the original issue #211 repairs on the simpler CI implementation installed by PR #218.

- Capture Git HEAD and Node version output and exit status separately. Require one output line before trimming and comparing it. Report the failed native command accurately.
- Retry the same immutable Git fetch at most three times, with a two-second pause between failures and an accurate terminal error. Bound the official Node download retries and timeouts. Keep HTTPS-only transfer and reviewed archive verification before extraction.
- Set the fixed npm configuration before its first command. Remove inherited npm settings in every npm process, including mixed-case names and punctuation that Bash cannot represent as variables. Stop before npm if environment enumeration fails. Persist the intended user/global configuration paths without assuming that one step can remove another

PSStyleGuide lacked the landed Terraform implementation's truthful npm launch and signal outcomes and bounded visible-mount cache admission.
